description: An agent-native red-teaming workspace with a fast browser, direct HTTP traffic control, sandboxed execution, and auditable sessions. Pure Rust.

written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
Support nuclei (#665)

* add flow-and-verdict design doc

* add shared expect matcher in h5i-wire

* wire expect verdict into websec sequence

* let h5i test decide by expect when there is no oracle

* add nuclei template importer to websec plugin

* refuse executable nuclei protocols on import

* parse single raw requests in nuclei importer

* add header-block and response matcher leaves

* drop nuclei output extractors instead of refusing on them

* update coverage note in flow-and-verdict design

* add portable payload sweeps to h5i test and the importer

* update coverage figure after payload sweeps

* add bounded dsl evaluator as an expect leaf

* add hashing, encoding and version dsl functions

* expose common response headers as dsl variables

* document the dsl evaluator and update coverage

* import nuclei multi-request raw blocks as variants and chains

* update coverage to 58 percent after multi-request support

* refuse favicon-hash dsl and dedup chain detection

* fix chain-lowering fidelity gaps found in review

* shorten the design docs added this branch
